items.title: Captain Verne Streckfus Interview, 1960-09-22
items.q: He played with Peyton Marlowe... we were in the honors for 20, 25 years

ctx.x: And who did he play with?
He'd been on the boats, but I didn't know when.

items.title: Captain Verne Streckfus Interview, 1960-09-22
items.q: I think Maribor could read because he was, his mother was a pianist, he was the Duke of Kentucky.

ctx.x: Yes, I believe that, uh, they were a little later than the original fellas, and then they began to read. I think Maribor could read because he was, his mother was a pianist, he was the Duke of Kentucky. That's why he could lead a band of colored fellas that, uh, in other words, he could read the music. That's why he loved. The men didn't have to read the, he could play it through on the piano first, and they could digest it from there on. But the rest of the men didn't read very good.
